claims.claim_text: 官方說常態下「一次連線裡有 95% 的資料是裝置之間直接傳的」，過去 30 天光是 relay 上就建立了超過兩億個端點。
claims.location: item-01「Iroh 1.0——用公鑰撥號，而不是用 IP」
claims.evidence: It's normal to see 95% of data transferred in a connection pass directly between devices. / The public relays we run have seen more than 200 million endpoints created, in the last 30 days alone.
claims.note: Core thesis 'Dial keys. Not IPs.', QUIC multipath + NAT traversal with relay fallback, v1 wire-protocol/API stability, and the supported language list (Python, Node.js, Swift, Kotlin in addition to the Rust crate) are all confirmed verbatim in source.

claims.claim_text: 支援 variable fonts，一個字型檔就能調粗細與寬度；HTML 匯出改用 MathML，公式變成可選取、能被螢幕報讀、瀏覽器也能高解析度算繪，取代過去不可存取的 SVG 做法。
claims.evidence: Variable fonts let font designers express glyph outlines and metrics in a parametric way, such that different weights, widths, and more can be derived from a single outline definition. / MathML equations keep text selectable, can be read out aloud with a screen reader, and be rendered at high resolution by browsers.
claims.note: Bundle export and native multiple-bibliography support are also confirmed in source.

claims.claim_text: 只要有任何方法能在不寫 unsafe 的情況下讓 library 觸發記憶體錯誤，那永遠是 library 的 bug；而在 C/C++ 裡，同樣的誤用通常被歸成「呼叫端用錯」。
claims.location: item-03「同樣一個記憶體 bug，為什麼在 Rust 算 CVE、在 C/C++ 不算」
claims.evidence: in Rust, when it is in any conceivable way possible to use a library such that a memory bug occurs, without using `unsafe` in the user code, it is always a bug in the library, not in the user code. / in C and C++ ... we create CVEs for specific misuses of a library, not for the existence of a library API that can be misused.
claims.note: Source also supports that Rust does not eliminate logic bugs, unsafe-block bugs, or compiler bugs. The specific curl_getenv(NULL) example is the post's illustration of the misuse framing the source asserts.

claims.claim_text: 大約每 1000 列打包成一批，每一批變成壓縮表裡的一列、欄位都成了陣列……時間戳用 delta 與 delta-of-delta、浮點數用 Gorilla 式的 XOR、重複值用 run-length、字串與 JSONB 走字典……官方宣稱最高可達 98% 壓縮率。
claims.location: item-04「TimescaleDB 怎麼把時序資料壓到剩零頭——Hypercore」
claims.evidence: Converting a chunk groups rows into batches of up to 1000 and each batch becomes a single row in the compressed table, in which the columns are arrays. / XOR-based compression (based on Gorilla) ... delta encoding, delta-of-delta ... run-length encoding ... compression of up to 98%.
claims.note: Hybrid row+columnar engine, segmentby/orderby roles, and string/JSONB dictionary compression all confirmed. minmax sparse-index batch-skip not surfaced verbatim by the fetch but the load-bearing numbers/mechanisms are supported.

claims.claim_text: 改成發一筆 HTTPS DNS record（RFC 9460），把 alpn="h3,h2" 連同 IP hint 一起寫進 DNS，瀏覽器在解析網域時就拿到，能在「最初一次連線」就直接挑 QUIC。省下的是一趟探路往返，視網路距離大概值 5 到 150 毫秒以上。
claims.location: item-05「發一筆 HTTPS DNS record，讓第一次連線就走 HTTP/3」
claims.evidence: An HTTPS record (RFC 9460) carries the same 'I speak HTTP/3' signal, but in the DNS. The client reads it during the name resolution it was going to do anyway, before it opens any connection. So it can make its very first connection over QUIC/HTTP/3. / roughly 5 to 20 ms within a city, 40 to 80 ms across a country, and 150 ms or more across an ocean or a mobile network.
claims.note: Alt-Svc 'learned only after connecting' framing also confirmed. The post's '5 到 150 毫秒以上' faithfully spans the source's 5ms (city) to 150ms+ (ocean) range.

claims.claim_text: 對 Routing Assets Database（RADb）下 WHOIS 查詢，就能把某個 ASN 註冊過的 route 與 IP 前綴撈出來……不必登入、用內建工具就能上手的查法。
claims.location: item-06「用 whois 查 RADb，把一個 ASN 註冊的路由翻出來」
claims.evidence: whois -h whois.radb.net -- "-i origin AS136907" | grep 'route:' | cut -d' ' -f 11 ... HTTPS-based queries will require an access token (implying the plain WHOIS path does not).
claims.note: Source shows the exact WHOIS-against-RADb command for pulling routes registered by an ASN, and notes that only HTTPS-based queries need a token — confirming the 'no login needed' claim.

claims.claim_text: Slack 工程團隊用 200 多次實跑比較三種端對端測試模型……傳統 deterministic 測試一次只花幾分錢、約三分鐘，agent 一次要 15 到 30 美元、跑五到十一分鐘……Playwright MCP 約 12%、生成式測試高達 48%。
claims.location: item-08「Slack 談 agentic testing 該擺在 E2E 測試的哪一層」
claims.evidence: we ran 200+ automated executions across multiple configurations ... agent-driven approaches cost $15–30 per execution and required 5–8 min (MCP) or 9–11 min (CLI) ... Playwright MCP: 0–12% ... Generated tests ~48% on complex workflows. Tests enforce journeys. Agents verify goals.
claims.note: All numbers supported: 200+ runs, $15-30, 5-11 min span (5-8 MCP / 9-11 CLI), MCP up to 12%, generated up to 48%. 'agents complement not replace' and 'tests force fixed path / agents verify the goal' confirmed.

claims.claim_text: 觀察某個生產級 LLM agent runtime 八週，整理出 22 件有完整根因分析的事故，提出一套五類的「無聲故障」分類……約七成的無聲故障是靠使用者察覺、而非測試或稽核抓到，而活最久的故障都長在元件之間、沒有任何測試跑過的接縫。
claims.location: item-09「把生產環境 LLM agent 的『無聲故障』分成五類」
claims.evidence: Over eight weeks we documented 22 incidents with full root-cause postmortems ... a five-class, mechanism-oriented taxonomy ... (D) chained hallucination and fabrication ... Class D is unique to LLM systems ... about 70% of silent failures were caught by human user-view observation, not tests or audits ... the longest-lived failures lived in the seams between components, where no test runs.
claims.note: Eight-week observation, 22 incidents, five-class taxonomy, class D unique to LLM systems, ~70% user-detected, and seams-between-components all verbatim in the abstract.

claims.claim_text: Daniel Stenberg 宣布 curl 七月整個月暫停收漏洞通報：HackerOne 通報表單到 8 月 3 日才重開，原訂的 8.22.0 版也順延到 9 月 2 日，GitHub 的 issue 與 PR 照常運作。
claims.location: item-10「curl 的『a summer of bliss』——七月暫停收漏洞通報」
claims.evidence: The curl project will not accept or otherwise handle any vulnerability reports during the month of July 2026 ... resumes on August 3 2026 ... 8.22.0 ... scheduled to happen on September 2, 2026 ... curl's issue and pull-request trackers on GitHub remain open and active like normal.
claims.note: All dates and the GitHub-stays-open claim confirmed verbatim; maintainer-rest / open-source sustainability framing also present in source.
